notes.title: Abraham’s faith “credited as righteousness”
notes.intro: Paul uses Abraham to show that God counts faith as righteousness.

views.label: Righteousness is credited (imputed) to believers
views.summary: Many Protestants see here God crediting Christ’s righteousness to those who believe, apart from their works.

views.label: God both declares and makes righteous
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians read the crediting of righteousness alongside real transformation of the believer by grace.

views.label: Faith as trust that leads to obedience
views.summary: Methodists and others emphasise that justifying faith is living trust that grows into holiness.
